def VTask.log (b n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if b ≤ 1 then
    0
  else
    if n = 0 then
      0
    else
      -- Use the built-in `Nat.log` function for the case when b ≥ 2 and n ≥ 1
      -- `Nat.log b n` returns the largest k such that b^k ≤ n
      Nat.log b n
